gate: independent cost of equity — a Ke that does not reproduce the price it is used to value

why_this_blocker_is_different.statement: G3's precision limit improves with elapsed time. G4's membership gap was closed today by reading official change records. This one does not yield to either, because it is not a data-volume problem — it is a circularity problem.
why_this_blocker_is_different.the_circularity: GLS-ICC is the discount rate that makes the residual-income model reproduce the CURRENT price. Using it as the discount rate in a same-date fair value computes the price from the price. The output would look like a valuation and carry no information.
why_this_blocker_is_different.what_therefore_counts_as_success: A Ke whose inputs are all knowable at the origin and none of which is derived from the same-date price of the asset being valued.

Rf_t.definition: US 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield, the last observation on or before the origin date, divided by 100
Rf_t.pit_rule: no observation dated after the origin may enter

Beta_industry.definition: Damodaran US industry levered beta, taken from the most recent annual archive whose publication date is on or before the origin date
Beta_industry.selection_rule: for origin t, choose the archive edition with the greatest publication date <= t. Never interpolate between editions, never average two editions, never use an edition published after t.
Beta_industry.levered_not_unlevered: the levered beta is used, because Ke is a cost of EQUITY and the target is a firm's equity holders
Beta_industry.repo_state: data/damodaran/industries.json holds 96 industries with levered/unlevered beta but is a SINGLE CURRENT SNAPSHOT. No dated archive exists in the repo.

MRP_hist.definition: arithmetic mean of (annual S&P 500 total return minus annual 10-year Treasury bond return), computed over an expanding window from 1928 through the last full year ending strictly before the origin
sensitivities_reported_without_threshold: the standard error envelope of the primary
MRP_hist.expanding_window_rule: for a 2019-06-30 origin the window ends 2018; for 2025-06-30 it ends 2024. No year containing the origin may enter.
MRP_hist.repo_state: data/damodaran/historical_erp.json holds 1960-2025 IMPLIED ERP (DDM and FCFE), which is a different quantity and belongs to the context lane, not here.

industry_mapping.why_it_is_frozen_here: Every firm must be assigned to a Damodaran industry before any Ke is computed. Choosing or adjusting that mapping after seeing valuation output is output targeting, and it would be invisible in the result.
industry_mapping.rule: map each firm's 2-digit SIC from data/edgar/r1-panel/sic/{sym}.json to a Damodaran industry using a mapping table committed BEFORE any Ke is computed, in its own commit
industry_mapping.unmappable_firms: a SIC with no defensible Damodaran counterpart is recorded UNMAPPED and excluded from the core Ke, with its count and index weight disclosed. It is not assigned to a nearest-looking industry.
industry_mapping.the_mapping_table_is_a_deliverable: FENO_RIM_SIC_TO_DAMODARAN_INDUSTRY_MAP.json, frozen in an earlier commit than any Ke history

uncertainty_is_the_output_not_a_footnote.reason: The historical equity premium carries a standard error of roughly 2 percentage points a year on a century of data. A Ke reported as a point estimate would hide the dominant source of error in the entire valuation.
uncertainty_is_the_output_not_a_footnote.requirement: every Ke is emitted as a range with named endpoints, never a scalar
uncertainty_is_the_output_not_a_footnote.endpoint_construction: Ke_low uses MRP_hist minus one standard error; Ke_high uses MRP_hist plus one standard error. Both endpoints carry the same Rf and Beta.

forbidden_uses: as the core discount rate for any successor fair value
as a replacement for a core band endpoint
as a tiebreak when the core range is inconvenient
context_lane_strictly_separated.why: the implied ERP is backed out of the same-date index price. It is exactly the circularity this gate exists to avoid, one level up.

korea_lane.CRP_source: most recent archived sovereign-rating-based country risk premium published on or before the origin, from the country-premium archive already restored to the repo (25 editions)
korea_lane.forbidden: any same-date KOSPI price-implied premium in the core
korea_lane.scope_note: Korea is not part of the SPX prototype and is specified here only so the contract is complete. B3 prototypes S&P 500 alone.

acquisition_scope.note: This mission's earlier gates forbade network acquisition. Mandate section 3.2 requires dated archives, so acquisition is now in scope for these two items only.

required.item: Damodaran historical annual returns dataset (S&P 500 total return, 10-year Treasury bond return, Treasury bill return, 1928 onward)
Damodaran US industry beta archives, annual editions covering 2018 through 2025

rules: official Damodaran publication only; no third-party republication as the ledger source
raw bytes retained with sha256 and a fetch receipt carrying first_knowable_at
no paid subscription, no login, no credential — mandate section 15 applies
if an edition for a given year cannot be obtained, that year is recorded MISSING and the selection rule falls back to the most recent earlier edition, with the substitution disclosed per origin

deliverables: FENO_RIM_KE_HISTORY.json — per firm, per origin: Rf, industry, beta, edition used, MRP point and standard error, Ke_low, Ke_point, Ke_high, and the provenance of every input
FENO_RIM_KE_CONTEXT_COMPARISON.json — core versus implied-context Ke, spread, sector distribution

verdict_rules.KE_CORE_IDENTIFIED: all three components resolve at every origin from dated sources published on or before that origin, industry mapping covers at least 90% of index weight, and no component derives from a same-date price of a valued asset
verdict_rules.KE_CORE_RANGE_ONLY: the above holds but the MRP standard error is wide enough that the Ke range spans more than 3 percentage points at the median firm — proceed, and every downstream fair value is a range
verdict_rules.KE_NOT_DEFENSIBLE: an archive edition cannot be obtained for a majority of origins, OR the industry mapping cannot cover 90% of index weight, OR any component turns out to require a same-date price
verdict_rules.range_only_does_not_block: mandate section 3.6 is explicit — RANGE_ONLY proceeds to the successor RIM with range outputs rather than points

prohibitions: no same-date price-implied quantity in the core Ke
no interpolation or averaging across archive editions
no industry-mapping change after any Ke or valuation is computed
no point-estimate Ke published without its range
no calibration of any component to a published Yoo figure
no paid acquisition, login, or credential
no publication or promotion; the public surface remains quarantined
